Positive requirements and completeness-sensitive restrictions retain omission penalties.
Q08 instructions distinguish prescribed guide rules from actual established household agreements.
residual_limitations: Q08 still receives does_not_satisfy probability .63 versus not_applicable .31 for the established-agreement scope question despite explicit quote-vs-fact instructions. This remains a judge error/limitation; do not interpret it as demonstrated application scope leakage.
Scores remain stochastic judge assessments under an uncalibrated threshold.
Averaging and partial credit may still mask some incomplete positive requirements.
source_integrity: All 20 source result hashes and final answers match prior evaluation; application was not modified or rerun.
